images.name: storm-hawk-bg.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone opaque background layer, storm-hawk-bg.png.
Output: PNG, exactly 1280x1024 pixels, 5:4 landscape aspect ratio.

SHARED STYLE:
Hand-painted gouache illustration with confident, visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain. Composition borrows from Japanese woodblock prints: bold silhouette, strong diagonal, generous negative space, flat layered planes of color. Limited palette of 5 colors: deep night navy (#0d1530), dusk lavender (#c9c3f0), storm violet (#5a3f8f), warm gold (#f6cf6a), pale mist (#f1f3fb). One clear light source, soft rim light, no lens flare. Shapes are simplified and graphic, not photoreal. Feels like a printed storybook plate, calm but magical.

SCENE:
Night storm over high mountains. The sky is mostly deep night navy (#0d1530) shading to a dark indigo near the horizon through flat painted tonal planes rather than smooth airbrushed gradients. Heavy thunderheads as flat, layered woodblock shapes in dark storm violet (#5a3f8f), lit only along their top edges by thin lavender rim light. One thin gold lightning fork far in the distance on the right, small and quiet. Lower third: near-black navy ridges with a soft band of pale mist between them. Overall the image is dark and low-key, about 75% dark values, so a pale lavender and gold creature placed over it will stand out strongly. Upper left is calm, empty dark sky. No animals or figures.

COMPOSITION AND VALUES:
Keep broad areas very dark, especially the upper-left negative space and the central region where a foreground creature could later be composited. Lavender is restricted to thin cloud-edge accents; pale mist forms a narrow, softly painted band between the mountain silhouettes. Full-bleed landscape, no border. The single distant gold lightning fork is the only light source. Do not render the foreground creature.

AVOID:
photorealism, 3D render look, glossy shading, airbrushed smooth gradients, HDR glow everywhere, bokeh, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures. No bright daytime sky, no large pale cloud faces, no animals or figures.
